'''Volume 5''' is the fifth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.
